key_insight: Industrial forecasting errors can come from the loss function’s built-in statistical prior, which creates regime-specific bias even when the temporal model is otherwise correct.
engineering_relevance: For deployed forecasting systems, regime-aware diagnostics can reveal and reduce pooling-induced bias that ordinary model ranking or scaling up model capacity may miss.
method: Introduced Regime-wise Relative Bias Vector (RBV) to decompose bias by demand regime.
Separated bias into an intrinsic floor from the loss estimand and an excess component from training.
Used controlled experiments to compare 13 loss objectives across multiple seeds and datasets.
evidence_signal: Across 60,000+ time series from RetailShiftBench and M5, with random-split controls, the study shows that regime-aware evaluation distinguishes optimization failures from bias failures.
watch_item: RBV depends on reliable regime labeling or detection, so practical deployment may be sensitive to how pathological subpopulations are defined.
paper_title: Beyond Model Ranking: Regime Diagnosis for Distributional-Statistical Misspecification in Industrial Time-Series Forecasting
